verdict.rationale: Eqvista is an equity management and valuation platform, so international valuations and country-specific option schemes are a fair question for it. The evidence only documents US-centric capabilities: 409A valuations by NACVA analysts, ASC 718, Rule 701 and Form 3921. Nothing mentions UK HMRC/EMI valuations, non-US option plans or support for international entities, and the generic "FMV Valuations" expedite line does not establish non-US scheme support.

support.subject: As an ops user, non-US valuations and schemes — UK HMRC/EMI valuations, country-specific option plans — are supported for my international entities
